newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Tannery's shares 667 oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Tannery's shares 667 oversubscribed.

text.p: Guangdong Tannery Ltd, a leather unit of conglomerate Guangdong Investment Ltd, said its offer of 30 million new shares to the public was 667 times oversubscribed.

In a statement issued on late Monday, the company said it also received 474 applications for the 71 million shares offered to its shareholders and the nine million shares allotted to employees were fully subscribed.
Guangdong Tannery is offering a total of 110 new shares at HK$1.03 per share for subscription.
Dealings in the company's shares would begin next Monday, the statement said.
Guangdong Investment will hold 75 percent of the company after the listing.
The net proceeds raised from the issue would be used to expand and upgrade production facilities in China, Guangdong Tannery said.
It was able to net an interest income of HK$14 million on the subscription funds, it said.
